任意波形发生器协调控制器
device_entry.description: 一个非物理的软件组件，用于在实验中统一管理、配置和编程一台或多台任意波形发生器（AWG）。它维护通道定义、查询时钟、协调主从AWG启动，并将序列与波形元素下发到受支持的AWG，证据显示其主要面向 Tektronix AWG5014，并部分支持 Zurich Instruments UHFLI。
device_entry.description_en: A non-physical software component for centrally managing, configuring, and programming one or more arbitrary waveform generators (AWGs) in experiments. It keeps channel definitions, queries clock rates, coordinates master/slave AWG startup, and uploads sequences and waveform elements to supported AWGs. The evidence indicates primary support for the Tektronix AWG5014 and partial support for the Zurich Instruments UHFLI.

schema.description: 定义并登记AWG通道及其延迟、偏置、电平、激活状态和所属AWG，用于后续波形映射与控制。
schema.description_en: Define and register an AWG channel with its delay, offset, levels, active state, and assigned AWG for later waveform mapping and control.

schema.description: 根据AWG名称或通道名称返回对应的AWG对象，用于定位目标仪器。
schema.description_en: Return the corresponding AWG object based on an AWG name or channel name to identify the target instrument.

schema.description: 获取指定通道对应AWG的采样时钟速率。
schema.description_en: Get the sampling clock rate of the AWG associated with a specified channel.

schema.description: 获取或设置已定义通道的配置选项。
schema.description_en: Get or set a configuration option for a previously defined channel.

schema.description: 返回当前已注册并处于活动使用状态的AWG名称集合。
schema.description_en: Return the set of AWG names that are currently registered and actively used.

schema.description: 将实验序列和波形元素编程到一个或多个AWG，上传波形并设置段顺序、循环和触发等待。
schema.description_en: Program one or more AWGs with an experimental sequence and waveform elements, uploading waveforms and setting segment order, looping, and trigger waiting.

schema.description: 根据当前保存的通道定义更新相关AWG的通道设置。
schema.description_en: Update AWG channel settings based on the currently stored channel definitions.

schema.description: 将保存的通道参数写入Tektronix AWG5014的设置中。
schema.description_en: Apply the stored channel parameters to the settings of a Tektronix AWG5014.
